scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @titlepipe/web exec prettier --check . && python3 scripts/run_python_checks.py format-check
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @titlepipe/web run format && python3 scripts/run_python_checks.py format
scripts.check:architecture: pnpm --filter @titlepipe/web check:rules && pnpm --filter @titlepipe/web check:imports && python3 scripts/check_backend_rules.py
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @titlepipe/web test && python3 scripts/run_python_checks.py test --projects unit
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run check:dead-code && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
